item.title: The price of diesel is showing up in the price of almost everything
item.description: Diesel has hit a record high. Stephan Bisaha visits an Alabama truck stop to talk with drivers and business owners about how high prices are changing what they spend and charge.
item.content:encoded: Diesel has hit a record high. Stephan Bisaha visits an Alabama truck stop to talk with drivers and business owners about how high prices are changing what they spend and charge.

item.title: A trucker explains what record diesel prices mean for his business
item.description: Monte Wiederhold runs a trucking company in northwest Ohio. He explains how problems overseas affect businesses at home.
item.content:encoded: Monte Wiederhold runs a trucking company in northwest Ohio. He explains how problems overseas affect businesses at home.

item.title: A year after Charlie Kirk's death, TPUSA is still influencing young conservatives
item.description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks with Ali Breland, who covers the far-right for The Atlantic, about the conservative youth organization Turning Point USA, now one year after Charlie Kirk's assassination.

item.title: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover
item.description: Even as anti-Muslim rhetoric rises in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are winning over diners and reshaping one of the state's most iconic culinary traditions.

item.title: U.S. Forest Service to keep some research stations open, after pushback about restructuring
item.description: In a massive restructuring under the Trump administration, U.S. Forest Service is closing dozens of research stations but, as NPR's Chiara Eisner reports, it is keeping some facilities open that had been projected to shutter.

item.description: Activist and author Angela Davis remembers her friend Gloria Steinem, and discusses intersectional feminism today.

item.title: Jazz legend John Coltrane's Philadelphia house to become a cultural heritage site
item.description: On the centennial of father's birth, Ravi Coltrane talks about turning the home where the jazz legend spent a crucial period in the 1950s into a cultural heritage and community space.

item.title: The Republican midterm convention is taking place in the heart of Bush country
item.description: The Republican midterm convention in Dallas takes place in the same city that helped give rise to the Bush political dynasty. Still, many policies championed by the conservative presidents are noticeably absent from today's Republican Party.

item.description: NPR's Bobby Allyn talks about covering the prediction markets, where anyone can trade bets on the outcome of anything happening in the real world.
